items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Did Tadd Dameron play with you for a long time? Yeah -- not a long time, but he played with me.

ctx.x: Oh, Now you're talkin' entertainment, these guys -- well that's what they need, They need something and they really appreciate it. It's no problem. Everything is nice, you know. You can even get to hang out to a certain extent. I know quite a few fellas up there, you know. So, I'll be glad to do it. I got the personnel, it's just a matter of what the date is going be. I don't even know what the name of the prison -- I think it's Raybrook.
So, you said you played in Cleveland for a while, and then you went to Detroit and traveled around a bit -- Canada -- but you did end up in Philadelphia for quite some time too.
Oh yeah, well I was in Chicago, too, for a while, and when I hit Philadelphia --
